name: membership-checkout-private-rpc
transport: Cloudflare named WorkerEntrypoint private RPC; all HTTP handlers return 404
scope: isolated-staging only; authenticated human identity must be established by the trusted caller, not these RPC fields
invariants: No caller-selected amount, package, route, recipient, currency, provider or principal.
Only the private trusted caller supplies a securely derived userId; no public browser API exists here.
Prepare stores original checkout instructions. Their existence is not proof of payment, membership activation or a current offer.
Same original operation key returns the original immutable response under current authorization; do not replace the key after an unknown outcome.
Read recomputes current status; mayPresentPaymentInstruction is true only for pending_current.
paymentEvidenceAllocated is true only for allocated; no receipt or status is external settlement attestation.
Checkout preparation must never dial a USSD code or call a provider. A real client requires separate explicit payment action and server-confirmed evidence.
Unrecognized errors after write invocation are unknown outcomes; no automatic client write retry.
Twenty new requests per club/user over a rolling fifteen-minute window is a pilot control, not a production-approved quota.
